_comment: Zone-map frames in world yards (left/right = y west edge/east edge, top/bottom = x north/south). WoW: Forever re-framed four zone maps; for every other zone the Era (Classic) frame and the live frame are the same. Era frames from Polestar's map-frames table (github.com/fitzforge/polestar, rust/tests/golden/data/expected/map-frames.json at the pinned commit). Live frames are not listed: they are our zone bounds, and build-data checks them against Polestar's ui_map table on every run.

imageryEra._comment: Zones whose map imagery (the wowforever.gg terrain we draw) is laid out in the Era frame, stretched over the live zone bounds. Checked by eye: in Eastern Plaguelands the Light's Hope gryphon master, innkeeper and Lord Maxwell Tyrosus land on the chapel only through the Era frame (through the live frame they fall ~500 yd west, in the blight); in Mulgore, Redridge and Stormwind the innkeepers land on their inns through the live frame.
